title: introduce-retry-watermark-and-idempotency-context-for-multiplexed-tool-streams
author: Elena Rivera
description:
Motivation: multiplexed streaming and tool/function calls expose subtle race conditions around retries and idempotency when requests are concurrently routed, retried, or partially acknowledged. Existing behavior relied on opaque Retry-After hints and an ad-hoc idempotency key semantics that caused duplicate side effects in rare failure windows. This PR introduces two interoperable primitives and related server-side controls: 1) a machine-readable Retry-Watermark header that carries a bounded, monotonic token describing the server's current retry window and partial-ACK state; 2) an Idempotency-Context header that scopes idempotency to a tool-call session (session id + optional call index) and allows the bridge to reconcile retries across multiplexed frames.

What this changes:
- API contract: clients can send Idempotency-Context to declare the logical tool-call session; servers will include Retry-Watermark on 429/503/retryable frames when stateful partial progress exists.
- Error envelopes: adds explicit machine-readable error codes in the structured error envelope (code: rate_limited | retry_window | session_mismatch | capacity_degraded) and a consistent retry_hint object with fields (preferred_wait_seconds, watermark_token).
- Runtime: server-side enforcement of a bounded retry window per model-pool (default 30s) and an optional conservative fallback policy to a stateless variant when watermark indicates session mismatch.
- Backwards compatibility: servers still honor Retry-After and legacy idempotency-key headers. Retry-Watermark is additive: clients/SDKs are encouraged to prefer Retry-Watermark when present for deterministic retry orchestration.

Implementation summary:
- API layer: add parsing/validation for Idempotency-Context and generation of Retry-Watermark tokens (base64 HMAC over pool-id, monotonic counter, expiry).
- Runtime: attach per-request watermark state to streaming multiplexers and tool-call sessions; introduce graceful fallback to stateless model variant when watermark mismatch detected.
- OpenAI-compat shim: map Retry-Watermark + structured error codes into OpenAI-style 429 with a machine-readable JSON body under "error.meta.retry_hint" for SDKs that consume only the body.
- SDK changes (python/ts): small handling code to propagate Idempotency-Context and surface retry_hint to callers; tests added.
- Docs: new API section documenting the headers, example retry loops, and migration guidance for existing idempotency-key usage.

Checklist:
- [x] Add Retry-Watermark header generation and validation
- [x] Implement Idempotency-Context parsing and session scoping
- [x] Add structured error codes and retry_hint mapping
- [x] Add unit tests for watermark token expiry and session reconciliation
- [x] Add E2E test for multiplexed stream retry scenario
- [x] Update openai-compat adapter to include retry_hint mapping
- [x] Update python and typescript SDKs with propagation helpers
- [x] Add docs and upgrade notes

Backwards-incompatible notes: default retry window shortened from 60s to 30s for model pools where Retry-Watermark is enabled (configurable). Migration guidance included in docs.

Linkages: this work is a follow-up to ENG-7420 and touches run-time batching and stream framing components. Design doc: internal/notes/retry-watermark.md (linked in PR comments).
commits: 4 commits: 1) initial impl of watermark/token generation and header plumbing; 2) runtime multiplexer plumbing + fallback policy; 3) tests + openai-compat adapter mapping; 4) docs, SDK helpers, and CI fixes.

review_conversation:
Marcus Li: Please clarify the semantics around watermark expiry. Is it safe for clients to retry after expiry or must they start a new session?
Elena Rivera: Watermark expiry indicates server can no longer reconcile partial state. Clients may retry but will get a session_mismatch code; recommended flow is to start a fresh session id when session_mismatch is returned. Added docs and tests to cover this.
Sofia Patel: Concerned about token size and privacy (pool id leakage). Can we HMAC with server-only key?
Elena Rivera: Yes — tokens are HMACed with an internal signing key; docs updated to note tokens are opaque and must not be interpreted by clients beyond equality/expiry.
Jonah Brooks: CI flake in e2e occurred due to timing of watermark expiry; suggested making tests less timing-sensitive.
Elena Rivera: Adjusted test to use deterministic clock injection and re-ran CI. CI initially failed on lint step (tslint rule) then passed after formatting fix.
Sofia Patel: Approving pending one small doc wording change. Doc wording updated. Marcus Li: Approved. Merge done via squash.
release_notes:
- Add Retry-Watermark header and Idempotency-Context to improve deterministic retries for multiplexed streams and tool calls.
- Introduce structured error codes and retry_hint object for machine-readable retry instructions.
- Shorten default retry window for watermark-enabled pools to 30s (configurable).
